---
name: Tracking defect
about: Report a reproducible tracking problem without private recordings
---

## Version and configuration
Repository commit/release, headset model (no serial), GPU model/driver, OS/desktop, selected profile.

## Expected and observed behavior
Separate head motion, controller motion, floor/origin, aim/model alignment and display symptoms.

## Reproduction
Short steps, whether head/controllers were moving, light/occlusion conditions in general terms. Do not attach room images, raw tracking streams, full logs, registry data or calibration blobs.

## Evidence boundary
User observation, deterministic test, or controlled measurement? State what is unknown. Positive tracking flags and stationary tests do not establish accuracy.

## Regression
Last known better version; one relevant change if known. Do not perform uncomfortable repeated tests merely to complete this form.
